They are the yen-denominated "Furuhāto J Road III" and the foreign-currency "Furuhāto J Road Global III", in US or Australian dollars. Both add a three-health-question plan that raises the death benefit immediately. The maximum sum insured rises to 1.8 billion yen. The severe-nursing-care prepayment rider can now be attached to the yen product, with a 100 million yen claim limit per insured person.

summary_en: Sumitomo Life announced on 29 Nov 2024 that an employee seconded from NN Life to Sumitomo Life, between April 2022 and March 2024, leaked customer information to NN Life. The leak covered 1,965 people: corporate policyholder details and insured names and ages from Sumitomo Life's Tokyo 23-ward branches (excluding Senju), plus data on prospective corporate clients. No account or credit card data was included. NN Life reports no external leakage. Sumitomo Life will notify affected customers, put prevention measures in place, and run a help line until 31 Mar 2025.

title_en: Results of the investigation into 'inappropriate information acquisition by Company secondees'
summary_en: Sumitomo Life announced on 2026-02-09 the results of its investigation (April 2022 to October 2025) into improper information gathering by its staff seconded to partner insurance agencies. It found 780 items taken from 8 agencies, including sales results, agent evaluation criteria and other insurers' product information. It found no organized instruction and no misuse or third-party sharing. Its remedies are monitoring, collecting seconded staff's work devices, training and a compliance-led secondment policy. It plans to have no seconded staff at agencies by the end of March 2026.
